title: A Useful Man
notes: Source of truth for the edit. Durations are editorial; tools/animatic.py --fit extends any dialogue shot that is shorter than lead + line + gap and writes the new timings back here.
tool: 'keyframes' = Kling 4.0 Keyframes image-to-video from the plate (start frame only, 1080p, 5 s); 'avatar' = Kling Avatar from the plate plus the line WAV; 'edit' = made in the comp.
line_new: true marks dialogue not on the pages (cold open lines are from episode 1; only 'Lovely people.' is new).
Lettering (sign, flyer headline, SFX words, titles) is added in the comp; plates carry no text except print on a named prop.
clip: an existing approved test clip that already covers the shot (in_sec = cut point inside the take).

shots.action: HQ kitchen, wide. The Count turns the eggs with the spatula, face to the pan; the Major drops two slices into the toaster. The fridge sign reads DAYS WITHOUT POOP FLING: 1 (lettering checked in the plate, or comped in the edit).
shots.speaker: count
shots.prompt: A shabby cluttered kitchen. The ape in the navy coat and floral apron on the left turns two fried eggs in the pan with a spatula, his face to the pan. The stocky ape in the grey military tunic and steel helmet on the right drops two slices of bread into the chrome toaster and looks down at it, eager. The card on the fridge stays exactly as in the image. Camera locked, eye level. Natural, restrained movement. Faces, costumes and helmet stay exactly as in the image. No text, no sound-effect lettering.
shots.note: The Count's line plays over this wide; his face is to the pan so no lip sync is needed.

shots.speaker: major
shots.prompt: Kling Avatar from the plate plus the line WAV. Performance: speaks brightly and proudly, a small confident nod, hand stays on the lever. Clear mouth movement on every syllable, face stays a mask, helmet and costume still, camera locked. No text.

shots.action: Insert: the Major's hand pushes the lever down; the toaster sparks, both slices blacken and smoke. PFFT.

No text, no sound-effect lettering.

She clasps her hands under her chin and watches the figurine. Camera locked, eye level. Natural, restrained movement. Faces, costumes and helmet stay exactly as in the image. No text, no sound-effect lettering.

shots.action: Medium. He holds it against his chest, concentrating; it bursts in his hands; shards and the spring fly; the tune dies mid-phrase. KRRK-PLONK.
shots.prompt: The ceramic clown figurine slips out of the ape's hands, drops onto the coffee table and shatters into ceramic shards; a small metal spring bounces out. The ape in the steel helmet freezes with his hands still raised. The woman beside him flinches. Camera locked. No text, no sound-effect lettering.
shots.note: Existing T2a PASS clip (the clown bursts in-hand at ~1.5 s).

shots.action: Locked two-shot over the shards. One second of silence. Then only the faces move: the Major's jaw drops, Laura's hands cover her mouth, her eyes crinkle.
shots.speaker: major
shots.prompt: Locked camera, nothing in the room moves except the two faces. The ape in the steel helmet slowly opens his mouth in dismay and looks from the broken figurine up to the woman. The woman raises both hands to cover her mouth; her eyes crinkle with delight she is trying to hide. Subtle, slow, natural. No text.
shots.note: Existing T2b PASS clip. 'Oh, no.' lands on his mouth opening; a two-syllable gasp needs no sync. Line starts about 1 s in.

No text, no sound-effect lettering.
